verdicts.evidence: COULD NOT CLEAR - filed as a hole because no measurement decided it (the isRegularFile precedent). Survived the unit pass and the whole-net legs of the release gate, and produced no observable difference - payload or rendered text - on any of the three probe missions. The compliance pack renders only via runward compliance, which the probes do not run; the recipe is a compliance <regime> draft diffed pristine-vs-mutant. compliance was measured by the first CI sweep and missed by the re-measure/filing lists of the consolidated pass (said plainly: an omission, caught by the release-gate ratchet - the gate doing its job on its own register). Probe suite (2026-09-08, same recipe as the consolidated pass): three init --example missions - nu (untouched), optin (structureContract:true), declencheur (optin plus an invalid **Date** field). Mutant applied by exact offset, check --strict --json AND the rendered text compared byte-for-byte on all three.
